result.instructions: Tools for FastBill, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my invoices are overdue, and who are the customers?"; "Show all invoices for customer Acme GmbH from this year."; "Create a draft invoice for customer 5376 with 10 hours of consulting at 120 EUR plus 19% VAT.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes FastBill data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run fastbill_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run fastbill_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run fastbill_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. fastbill_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: fastbill_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (name, address, e-mail, VAT id, payment terms and bank details as stored in FastBill). Filter by search term (organization, name, address, zip, e-mail or tags), customer number, country or city. customer.get.

term.description: Search term matched against organization, first/last name, address, zip code, e-mail and tags.

country_code.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE.

limit.description: Results per call, 1-100 (default 25). Every call counts against FastBill's hourly API quota.

offset.description: Index of the first result, from 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

end_date.description: Invoices dated up to this day.

limit.description: Results per call, 1-100 (default 25). Every call counts against FastBill's hourly API quota.

tools.name: fastbill_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer. customer_type is required; a business needs organization, a consumer needs last_name. Bank details are not accepted by this tool. FastBill does not check for duplicates, so search with fastbill_list_customers first. customer.create.

organization.description: Company name (required for a business customer).

customer_number.description: Own customer number (FastBill assigns one if omitted).

days_for_payment.description: Days until payment is due (stored with payment_type 1 only).

payment_type.description: 1 transfer, 3 cash, 4 PayPal, 5 advance payment, 6 credit card (direct debit needs bank details: set it in FastBill).

tools.name: fastbill_update_customer
tools.title: Update customer
tools.description: WRITE: update fields of an existing customer; only the fields you pass change. Bank details are not accepted by this tool. customer.update.

organization.description: Company name (required for a business customer).

customer_number.description: Own customer number (FastBill assigns one if omitted).

days_for_payment.description: Days until payment is due (stored with payment_type 1 only).

payment_type.description: 1 transfer, 3 cash, 4 PayPal, 5 advance payment, 6 credit card (direct debit needs bank details: set it in FastBill).

tools.name: fastbill_create_invoice
tools.title: Create invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create an invoice for a customer from line items. FastBill stores it as a draft; it gets its number and becomes final only with fastbill_complete_invoice, and it is never sent by this tool. Check the result with fastbill_get_invoice. invoice.create.

unit_price.description: Price per unit (net, or gross when is_gross is true).

article_number.description: Article number of a FastBill product.

is_gross.description: True when unit_price values are gross.

tools.name: fastbill_complete_invoice
tools.title: Finalize invoice
tools.description: WRITE, NOT REVERSIBLE: turn a draft invoice into a final invoice. FastBill assigns the invoice number and PDF; a final invoice can no longer be edited (it can only be canceled in FastBill). Nothing is sent to the customer. Only call this after the user confirmed the draft. invoice.complete.

invoice_id.description: FastBill id of the DRAFT invoice.

tools.name: fastbill_set_invoice_paid
tools.title: Mark invoice paid
tools.description: WRITE: mark a final invoice as paid, with the payment date and method. invoice.setpaid.

paid_date.description: Date the payment arrived (default: FastBill's choice, today).

tools.name: fastbill_create_estimate
tools.title: Create estimate
tools.description: WRITE: create an estimate (quote) for a customer from line items. It is not sent. estimate.create.

unit_price.description: Price per unit (net, or gross when is_gross is true).

article_number.description: Article number of a FastBill product.

is_gross.description: True when unit_price values are gross.

tools.name: fastbill_create_article
tools.title: Create product
tools.description: WRITE: create a product or service (article number, title and unit price are required). article.create.

tools.name: fastbill_create_project
tools.title: Create project
tools.description: WRITE: create a project for a customer (name and customer are required). project.create.

tools.name: fastbill_create_time_entry
tools.title: Create time entry
tools.description: WRITE: book a work time entry on a project (customer, project and start time are required). time.create.

minutes.description: Duration in minutes (not calculated from the times).

article_id.description: The service (article id) of the entry.
